utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Saturday at 10 a.m. at the community center still works for me — I’ll just need to plan my route carefully.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Great, Saturday at 10 works. I’ll bring duct tape and a screwdriver, and I’ll ask a couple neighbors if they can lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, that helps — if we can get a few more hands, I think the timing should still work. I’ll plan to be there a little early so I can sort out parking.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’ll keep an eye out this afternoon and let you know if folks start coming by with tools or updates on what still needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Tess — I’ll keep spreading the word about the repair drive this Saturday at 10 a.m. at the community center. I’m also still making sure Pia has the details, and I’ll pass along anything Nell needs too.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sounds good — I’ll watch for anyone coming by this afternoon and tell you what I hear. If I catch any new details, I’ll pass them along right away.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out, and if Rosa pins down the time and place, let me know too.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll line it up around the school schedule and send the repair drive times as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Jules — that works for me. Just keep me posted once the repair drive time and place are set.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll help sort out who needs what for the repair drive and make sure folks know to pitch in. I’ll spread the word so everyone stays posted.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Vik — I’m going to join a bit late and just handle a small part. If Uli or Cleo let me know what’s still needed, I’ll fill one of the gaps.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good, Dane — I’ll check in with Uli and Cleo and let you know what gap still needs filling. We’ll keep everyone posted and make sure the repair drive stays on track.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m not sure the volunteer list is final yet, so I’ll check first. It’s this Saturday afternoon at the community hall, and I’ll let Mina know the exact start time once I confirm it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — send me the details once Rosa sends them over, and I’ll flag anything that looks off. I’m also keeping in mind that my place is the first stop.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Bo — I’ll wait for Rosa’s details and double-check the timing before I pass anything on.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’m still locking down the time and place for the repair drive, but I’ll send the details to Bo once I have them so he can give them a quick review.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: This afternoon, right? Just want to make sure folks are actually coming by to drop off tools and check what still needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I haven’t locked in this afternoon yet, but I’m aiming to confirm the time and place soon so folks can plan to stop by.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m keeping my schedule open and waiting on Oren’s update. I’ll bring the clear list of drop-off items tomorrow morning at the community center parking lot.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Eli — that helps a lot. I’m still good to help with sorting donations and the basic repairs tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, Sam — that keeps us on track. I’m still waiting for Oren’s time, and I’ll be there with the drop-off list tomorrow morning.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks — please send the times when you have them, and I’ll work around school pickups.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure — I’ll check the start time and let you know as soon as I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Mina — I appreciate it. Once you hear back, send the time and I’ll plan around pickups.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I’m still piecing together the plan and time, but I’ll let Eli know as soon as I’ve got it. If I hear anything about the repair drive, I’ll pass it along right away.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Oren. I’m headed to the community center parking lot tomorrow morning, and Bo’s place is the first stop.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Got it, thanks, Opal — I’ll keep an ear out and pass along any updates as soon as I hear them.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m heading out to run errands and ask around, and I should be home around 3. Leo can stop by then, and Oren can let me know if he hears anything.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Ira — I might’ve missed a few details, so having Vik help organize and keep everyone posted would really help.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll ask around while I’m out and be back around 3. If Oren or Vik hears anything, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great—Rey can bring duct tape and a screwdriver, and I’ll sort the list so Dane knows what we’re still short on.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect, that’ll help a lot. I’ll keep telling folks we’re focusing on broken household items and small furniture for Saturday afternoon at the community hall.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sounds good—I’ll keep the list focused on those items and let Dane know what’s still missing once I’ve sorted it.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ll be there around 3 this afternoon with the tool bag and a few tools for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Perfect, Gus. That’ll help a lot — we still need hands for sorting donations too.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — I’ll bring the tool bag and I’m happy to help sort donations too.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll help organize who needs what for the repair drive and spread the word so folks remember to pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’d be wonderful, Vik—thank you. I’m still finalizing the time and place, and I’ll send Bo the details as soon as they’re set so they can give them a quick review.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — once you’ve got the time and place, send it over and I’ll keep folks posted and help sort out who needs what.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’ll keep my schedule open and wait for Oren’s update. Once he shares the time, I’ll bring the list and head to the community center parking lot tomorrow morning.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Just a heads-up: it’s this Saturday at 10 a.m. at the community center, not tomorrow morning. I’d double-check the timing so we don’t miss it.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks for catching that, Pia. I’ll note Saturday at 10 a.m. at the community center and wait for Oren’s confirmation.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Let’s keep the repair drive small and straightforward. I’ll let Dane know where we need him when he arrives late.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sounds good — I’m still waiting on Rosa for the final time and place, so please keep me posted when you hear it.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Will do — once Rosa confirms, I’ll pass it along and keep everything simple.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I’m still piecing together the plan and time, but I’ll let Eli know as soon as I’ve got it. If I hear anything about the repair drive, I’ll pass it along right away.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So it’s still this afternoon, right? And people are just dropping off tools and checking what still needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yeah, that sounds right — I’m pretty sure it’s still this afternoon, and folks can drop off tools and see what’s left. I’ll confirm the time once I’ve got the details nailed down.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, I’ll be there around 3. We can use help sorting donations and a few tools for basic repairs.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Leo — that’ll help a lot. I’ll bring duct tape and a screwdriver, and I may ask a couple neighbors to lend a hand too.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Perfect — that should cover a lot. See you around 3.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’ll line up the repair drive around the school schedule and keep everyone posted. First I’m reaching out to the folks who asked for help, then I’ll check with the hardware store and the community center.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’m heading out for errands and I’ll ask around too. I should be home around 3, and Leo can stop by then if he needs to.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect, I’ll plan around 3 and keep Leo in the loop. Thanks for asking around too — I’ll update everyone as I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep — I’m planning to swing by around 3 this afternoon with the tool bag and a few extra tools for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’s great, Gus — 3 sounds perfect, and the extra tools will really help. I’m glad you’re coming by for the repair drive this Saturday at the community hall.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You bet — I’ll be there around 3 with the tool bag and a few extras. Looking forward to helping out at the community hall.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got the repair drive list sorted, and we’re still short a few hands plus some duct tape and screwdrivers. Rey can bring some tape and a screwdriver, and I’ll let Dane know the rest.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — I can help if you still need volunteers. Have you confirmed the start time yet?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Not yet, but I’m checking on it now. If you’re free, I’d love to add you to the volunteer list.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m heading to the community center parking lot tomorrow morning for the repair drive, and Bo’s place is the first stop. Eli’s bringing a clear list of drop-off items too.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, good — I’ll keep an eye out this afternoon for anyone coming by with tools and updates, and I’ll pass along what still needs fixing. It sounds like a busy one, so hopefully Bo’s place goes smoothly first.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That sounds perfect — I’ll check in at the community center parking lot tomorrow morning and keep Bo’s place at the top of the route.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh good, Vik can help organize who needs what—I may have missed a few details. And if Vik keeps everyone posted about the repair drive, that’d be a big help too.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’m spreading the word, and I’ll make sure Vik and the others have the details for Saturday at 10 a.m. at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Quinn — Saturday at 10 a.m. at the community center, got it. I’m glad Vik’s on it, because I definitely needed the reminder.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can help with sorting donations and do a few basic repairs too—just let me know when you need me.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Sam — I’d appreciate that. If you can send me the times, I’ll work around school pickup and let you know what fits.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll send you a couple of times that should work, and you can tell me what fits best.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’ll join a bit late and take on a small part of it. Just let me know where you need me most.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Dane. I’ll check the exact start time and whether they still need volunteers, then I’ll let Mina know where you’re most needed.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good — I’ll keep it simple and jump in wherever there’s a gap.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
